payload.posture: Read Psalms 103:17–21 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states the psalm names the LORD’s heavenly throne and a kingdom ruling over all before summoning creation to bless. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
